name: DeKalb
gaps: DeKalb's public layer has no deed-acre field. Acres are computed from the polygon inside a Shape__Area window, so this county is a large sample, not a certified complete roll.

Batch-40 join on 40 parcels: DCSD schools with GOSA 2025 CCRPI scores (no A–F letters), including two City of Atlanta parcels zoned to Druid Hills. NFHL flood zones are 31 X and 9 AE, with no published static BFE. Water and sewer name DeKalb DWM, or Atlanta DWM inside the City of Atlanta, as a jurisdiction proxy. Electric is HIFLD. Gas stays unknown. Opportunity Zone, income, and AADT are not in this join.
